featured.name: KYRO Café — Coffee, Breakfast & Pastries in Moalboal
featured.desc: KYRO Café is a modern, clean, and chill spot in Moalboal, praised for its welcoming staff and comfortable atmosphere. Popular highlights include strong coffee, coconut raf, hearty full breakfasts, and fresh mango yogurt bowls. With reasonable prices, fast service, and a diverse menu, it's an ideal choice for a delicious morning meal or a refreshing stop after a long trip.
featured.prices: Coffee from PHP 160, specialty drinks up to PHP 200; breakfasts and mains PHP 330. Average spend PHP 400–600 per person.
featured.photoAlt: Breakfast spread at KYRO Café: iced latte, oatmeal with mango, tapsilog and omelette

featured.name: PH Kawasan Canyoneering
featured.desc: PH Kawasan Canyoneering delivers an unforgettable, thrill-packed adventure set in breathtaking natural landscapes. Visitors consistently praise the exceptional guides who prioritize safety, keep energy high with humor, and take incredible photos and videos throughout the trek. The experience is seamlessly organized, featuring smooth morning pickups and a delicious lunch provided afterward. Practical tip: bring plenty of energy and courage, and trust your guides to take care of everything else!

featured.name: Near Dental Clinic - Camputhaw
featured.desc: Near Dental Clinic - Camputhaw offers a warm, spotless, and welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts patients at ease. Visitors consistently praise the gentle, highly professional dentists and friendly staff for painless treatments, punctual appointments, and thorough explanations of every step. It is a top recommendation for orthodontic care like braces and an ideal choice for anyone suffering from dental anxiety.

featured.name: The Great Finds Vintage Cebu
featured.desc: The Great Finds Vintage Cebu is a cozy, well-organized thrift shop offering a wide variety of unique vintage gems and stylish, masculine-leaning apparel in excellent condition. Shoppers praise the welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff, making it effortless to browse through their quality collections. While regular prices can feel a bit steep for a thrift store, visiting during their sales is highly recommended to grab the best deals.

featured.name: Nalu Dive
featured.desc: Nalu Dive offers a friendly, highly professional atmosphere that makes even first-time divers feel completely safe and relaxed. Guided by attentive instructors like O'Neil, visitors enjoy easy beach entries to explore vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and massive sardine runs. For a seamless trip, take advantage of their prompt pickup service, secure lockers, and delicious Japanese curry lunch between dives.

featured.name: RJR Minigolf Moalboal
featured.desc: RJR Minigolf Moalboal offers a charming, peaceful, and well-maintained 12-hole course filled with fun challenges, including particularly tricky 8th and 12th holes. Visitors consistently praise the exceptionally warm and welcoming owners, Ryza and Rene, who provide great tips, friendly conversation, and a delightful personal touch. Practical tip: Visit in the evening to play under cooler conditions, as the spot stays open until 10 PM and has drinks available on-site.

featured.name: LOY'S MOTORBIKE RENTAL
featured.desc: Loy's Motorbike Rental in Moalboal stands out for its warm, exceptionally professional, and customer-centric atmosphere. Key highlights include pristine, well-maintained scooters, personalized driving lessons for complete beginners, and helpful local travel recommendations. Practical tip: Easily arrange bookings, flexible rental extensions, hotel deliveries, and convenient bus stop drop-offs via WhatsApp or Messenger.

featured.name: Vape N' Hell - Mambaling Jai Alai
featured.desc: Vape N' Hell - Mambaling Jai Alai offers a cozy, cool, and welcoming atmosphere paired with exceptional customer service. Visitors consistently praise the friendly, knowledgeable staff who go out of their way to offer budget-friendly recommendations and helpful alternatives for first-time users. It is a highly recommended spot for a smooth shopping experience, though a minor tip from guests suggests adding outdoor greenery could enhance its curb appeal.

featured.name: Cebu baktas tourist transport
featured.desc: Cebu Baktas Tourist Transport provides an exceptionally smooth, reliable, and stress-free travel experience across Cebu. Travelers consistently praise drivers like Loyd for their punctuality, safe driving, spotless air-conditioned vehicles, and friendly local insights. Practical tip: in addition to comfortable transfers to destinations like Moalboal or Liloan port, the team can also seamlessly help organize local activities such as canyoneering tours.

featured.name: Spring Blossom Resto Bar
featured.desc: Spring Blossom Resto Bar offers a lively and welcoming atmosphere complete with delicious food, great drinks, and free karaoke. Guests consistently praise the reasonable prices, friendly owner, and accommodating team—making it a fantastic venue for both casual gatherings and large private events. A practical tip for party hosts is to explicitly request proactive table service, such as water refills, so the staff keeps up with your group's specific expectations.

featured.name: Flowers Direct Cebu
featured.desc: Flowers Direct Cebu is widely praised for its fresh, elegantly arranged bouquets and exceptional customer service that seamlessly handles long-distance surprises. Customers highlight the incredibly fast, punctual delivery and highly responsive staff who even answer queries before store hours. It is a hassle-free choice for any occasion, accommodating last-minute orders with ease. For the best experience, reach out directly to their responsive team for quick assistance with custom or urgent requests.

featured.name: Mandaue City Branch - RABIES BUSTER - Animal Bite Center/Clinic
Arjean’s waxing and nail spa
featured.desc: Arjean’s Waxing and Nail Spa offers a warm, welcoming, and professional environment where clients receive exceptionally attentive care. Renowned for her meticulous attention to detail, gentle touch, and expertise in BIAB and gel services, Arjean consistently delivers beautiful, long-lasting nails at very reasonable prices. Practical Tip: Booking is fast and easy via WhatsApp, and the salon is conveniently accessible by tuktuk for visitors in Moalboal.

featured.name: Astillo`s Guest Houses
featured.desc: Astillo’s Guest Houses offers a remarkably warm, peaceful, and home-like atmosphere with beautifully maintained grounds. Guests consistently praise the exceptional cleanliness, delicious breakfasts, and the incredibly kind hosts who provide genuine hospitality. For convenience, visitors can rent scooters directly on-site, use the laundry service, or ask the owners to arrange local transport and bus station transfers.

featured.name: The SHUIM Dive Resort 더쉼 다이브 리조트 모알보알
featured.desc: Located away from the noisy town center, The SHUIM Dive Resort offers a cozy, meticulously maintained beachfront atmosphere with exceptionally warm hospitality from its Korean owners. Highlights include delicious daily Korean meals, comfortable rooms with practical amenities like swimwear drying racks, and top-tier dive instruction with direct reef access to spot turtles and whale sharks. Guests can relax at the private beach or treehouse, interact with friendly resident pets, and easily organize bike rental delivery straight to the resort.

featured.name: BANANA BEACH CLUB
featured.desc: Banana Beach Club is a fresh, brand-new resort offering a relaxing island vibe with exceptionally clean rooms and warm, 24/7 attentive staff. Highlights include a pristine pool, beachfront snorkeling with free equipment, beach volleyball, and stunning sunset views. For practical tips, take advantage of their free tricycle transfers to nearby Panagsama Beach, though consider comparing prices locally if you plan to book external tours.

featured.name: RRS Review and Training Center - Cebu
Raymonds Barbershop
featured.desc: Raymond’s Barbershop in Moalboal offers an authentically warm, relaxed open-air experience where guests might even enjoy a cold beer while receiving a meticulous, highly professional haircut. Raymond is a remarkably skilled and attentive barber who delivers top-tier work for an unbeatable 150 PHP. Since his open-shack shop periodically faces typhoon damage, be sure to stop by for a fresh trim and leave a generous tip to help support his local business.

featured.name: i BLOOMED Skin & Aesthetic Clinic Cebu
featured.desc: i BLOOMED Skin & Aesthetic Clinic Cebu offers a clean, professional, and wonderfully relaxing atmosphere with exceptionally friendly, knowledgeable staff. Key highlights include highly effective treatments ranging from hair regrowth and acne control to permanent wart removal and radiant facials like the Glacial and Carbon peels. Both local visitors and international travelers praise the clinic for delivering visible, lasting results for skin and scalp care. Practical tip: maximize your appointment by treating yourself to a soothing facial while waiting for scalp numbing cream to take effect.

featured.name: Moalboal Cay Hostel
featured.desc: Moalboal Cay Hostel offers a quiet, welcoming sanctuary on a peaceful dead-end road just a two-minute walk from town, dive shops, and the beach. Guests adore the spotless, spacious apartment-style rooms with impressive noise cancellation, as well as the delicious complimentary breakfast, fantastic coffee, and friendly resident dogs. Helpful staff and affordable on-site scooter rentals make exploring Moalboal effortless, making this the ultimate spot for a relaxing stay.

featured.name: Tara Bar & Chill - Moalboal
featured.desc: Tara Bar & Chill in Moalboal boasts a cozy yet vibrant atmosphere with a stylish layout, great music, and a striking moon-themed wall. Guests rave about the exceptionally welcoming staff and owner, delicious food, and affordable signature drinks like classic mojitos and frozen margaritas. Whether you are looking to unwind with a casual drink after work or party all night with a fun crowd, this spot is a must-visit in Basdiot.

featured.name: Bible Believers Baptist Church- Moalboal
featured.desc: Bible Believers Baptist Church in Moalboal offers an exceptionally warm, welcoming, and family-like atmosphere for both locals and international travelers. Visitors frequently highlight the passionate biblical preaching, beautiful choir music, and remarkable hospitality that often includes shared lunches and rides. Services are conducted predominantly in English (alongside Bisaya) and start around 9:00 to 9:30 AM, making it very accessible for visiting tourists to follow along.

featured.name: NeatSpaces - Cebu
featured.desc: NeatSpaces - Cebu earns stellar reviews for its reliable, affordable, and amazingly thorough professional cleaning services. Clients highlight their easy communication, punctual staff, and meticulous attention to detail—from rearranging heavy furniture to leaving bathrooms squeaky clean and fresh-smelling. It is an ideal choice for both regular upkeep and deep cleaning, especially recommended for local Airbnb hosts looking to boost their ratings.

featured.name: AGS Worldwide Movers - Philippines, Cebu City
featured.desc: AGS Worldwide Movers in Cebu City delivers an exceptionally professional, stress-free relocation experience built on top-tier international standards. Key highlights include meticulous damage-free packing, swift customs clearance, proactive communication, and attentive crews who assist with assembly, cleanup, and even car washing. For expats moving internationally or transferring vehicles domestically, working directly with their local Cebu branch is a great practical tip for ensuring a seamless, on-budget move.

featured.name: Kalynn Souvenir Shop
featured.desc: Kalynn Souvenir Shop at Panagsama Beach is a welcoming local store known for its exceptionally warm and helpful staff. Visitors love the vast selection of souvenir T-shirts, mini dresses, and local keepsakes available in a variety of styles, sizes, and colors. It offers fair prices with no tourist markup, and fitting clothes before buying is warmly encouraged.

featured.name: SHARKEEZ RESTO BAR
featured.desc: Sharkeez Resto Bar is a chill and welcoming spot in Moalboal featuring a spacious seating area, affordable drinks, and free pool. Visitors consistently praise the extraordinary hospitality of the friendly owners, great music, and vibrant atmosphere. Tucked just a short 30-step walk off the main road, keep in mind that food service might be limited during ongoing renovations and restrooms can occasionally lack supplies.

featured.name: Let's Go Trek Tours
featured.desc: Let's Go Trek Tours offers an exhilarating, high-energy canyoneering adventure in Badian filled with stunning waterfalls, optional jumps, and a thrilling zipline start. Visitors consistently praise the outstanding 1:1 guide-to-guest ratio, highlighting the team's exceptional focus on safety, friendly support for hesitant trekkers, and expert photo capturing. For the best experience, bring your own towels, prepare for a moderate physical workout, and book an early 7:00 AM slot to beat the crowds.

featured.name: M&R Medical Aesthetics and Wellness Center
featured.desc: M&R Medical Aesthetics and Wellness Center offers a clean, relaxing, and discreet environment where Dr. Mike and Rowi provide exceptionally attentive, personalized, and safety-focused care. Clients praise their educational approach and highly effective results across procedures like PRP hair restoration, natural Botox, sclerotherapy, and weight loss support. For the best experience, feel free to discuss any health conditions or scheduling constraints openly, as the team prioritizes patient wellbeing above all.

featured.name: Amity Medical Clinic
featured.desc: Amity Medical Clinic offers an exceptionally professional, welcoming, and remarkably efficient healthcare experience for travelers and locals alike. Patients praise the friendly, fluent English-speaking staff and knowledgeable doctors who deliver thorough, reassuring care. Walk-ins are seamlessly accommodated with minimal wait times, allowing visitors to get vitals checked, see a doctor, and receive medication in as little as 15 minutes at very affordable prices.

featured.name: B&E Money Changer
featured.desc: B&E Money Changer is highly regarded for offering some of the best exchange rates in town alongside a friendly, trustworthy atmosphere. Customers consistently highlight smooth, reliable, and completely legitimate transactions handled by approachable staff. For a hassle-free and dependable currency exchange experience, this spot comes highly recommended.

featured.name: O Delices French Bakery
featured.desc: O Delices French Bakery is a charming gem in Moalboal, offering a cozy oasis with both air-conditioned indoor seating and pleasant alfresco dining. Guests rave about the authentic in-house baked pastries, outstanding eggs benedict, delicious pastas, and quality deli selections. It is a perfect spot to recharge after snorkeling with dedicated parking, though visitors should note that it is a cash-only establishment.

featured.name: Kamakura
featured.desc: Soba house in Casuntingan, Mandaue, with buckwheat noodles made in-house. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Asian Home Appliance Center - Moalboal
featured.desc: Asian Home Appliance Center in Moalboal offers a welcoming, customer-focused atmosphere backed by fair pricing and great deals. Reviewers consistently praise the friendly and accommodating staff—including standout team members like Julius—who provide clear feature explanations and valuable maintenance advice. For the best experience, be sure to ask the knowledgeable team for personalized recommendations and care tips on your appliance purchases.

featured.name: Oliva Massage & Spa
featured.desc: Oliva Massage & Spa provides an impeccably clean, serene, and welcoming atmosphere designed for ultimate relaxation. Guests rave about skilled therapists, customized massage pressure, full-back heated packs, and thoughtful touches like complimentary tea and loyalty rewards. For a seamless visit, easily book online or via phone in advance, and prepare for an intense yet rejuvenating steam session if trying their popular Moroccan Bath.

featured.name: Whale Shark Dive Camp
featured.desc: Whale Shark Dive Camp offers a peaceful, laid-back beachfront escape away from Oslob's crowds, featuring spacious, pristine rooms with breathtaking ocean views. Guests praise the exceptionally helpful staff and seamless diving experiences with Deep Zone Dive Center, covering whale sharks, Sumilon Island, and vibrant night dives. For the best experience, stay at least a couple of nights, book your night dives early, and enjoy snorkeling right off the private beach.

featured.name: Nug-as Forest Reserve
featured.desc: Nug-as Forest Reserve is a serene, eco-friendly sanctuary offering a refreshing cool climate and a peaceful ambiance perfect for escaping urban stress. Nature enthusiasts will love its secluded charm and the chance to spot unique local wildlife like the siloy bird. It is an ideal destination for anyone seeking peace of mind, solitude, and a total stress-relieving reset in nature.

featured.name: Lantaw (Compostela)
featured.desc: Open-air native restaurant over the water in Compostela, known for grilled seafood and sunset views. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: LASA BUSAY Modern Filipino Food
featured.desc: LASA BUSAY offers incredible modern Filipino cuisine paired with a relaxed atmosphere and astounding panoramic views of Cebu City near the Temple of Leah. Guests rave about the flavorful, beautifully presented dishes—with the crispy fried suman highlighted as a must-try—alongside attentive service and generous portions. It is an ideal spot to recharge during a sightseeing trip, with a convenient car drop-off available at the top to bypass the steep incline from the parking area.

featured.name: Eskapo Verde Lodge Moalboal
featured.desc: Eskapo Verde Lodge is a serene, eco-friendly sanctuary nestled in a lush mangrove forest with direct ocean access, far from the hustle of Moalboal. Guests consistently praise the pristine wooden cottages, incredibly welcoming staff, and an outstanding restaurant offering fresh meals with great vegetarian options. Note that the property is about a 15-minute ride from the town center, so renting a scooter or taking a local tricycle is recommended for getting around.

featured.name: Go|Social Coworking Space Cebu
featured.desc: A 24-hour coworking space in the ADG IT Center on Lopez Jaena Street, Mandaue — fibre internet, air-conditioning, meeting rooms and dedicated desks, with round-the-clock access for members on different time zones. One of the few Cebu spaces open at any hour, which makes it practical for remote workers billing clients in Europe or the US.

featured.name: The Kabilin Center
featured.desc: The Kabilin Center offers an engaging and well-lit cultural space that beautifully showcases Cebuano heritage, from local food history and fisherfolk traditions to aesthetic handmade garments. Friendly, knowledgeable guides and creative touches—like interactive projections—make the insightful exhibits truly come alive. Though compact, this uncrowded museum is a gem, offering free admission if you present a ticket from nearby Casa Gorordo.

featured.name: COCO
featured.desc: Second-floor gem in Mactan Seaport Village with bamboo interiors and a menu mixing Filipino and Thai flavours. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Socarrat
featured.desc: Spanish comfort food in Bonifacio District — patatas bravas, lengua estofada and paella. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Moalboal Post Office
featured.desc: Moalboal Post Office offers quick, efficient service with exceptionally friendly, English-speaking staff who go above and beyond to help resolve delivery issues. Conveniently located inside the Municipal Building to the left of the main entrance, it provides standard mailing options, postcard stamps for 35 Pesos, and shipping boxes from 2kg to 30kg. Keep in mind that payment is cash-only, shipping liquids is prohibited, and sending packages abroad can be somewhat pricey.

featured.name: SM Seaside City Cebu
featured.desc: SM Seaside City Cebu is a massive, modern, and lively mall offering a beautiful seaside view alongside a vast selection of shops, dining, and entertainment. Visitors benefit from a safe environment, free parking, and convenient bus transportation that makes commuting effortless. Due to its immense size, be prepared for plenty of walking, visit on weekdays to avoid crowds, and double-check ride restrictions before purchasing tickets at family attractions.

featured.name: Enye by Chele Gonzalez
featured.desc: Spanish cuisine by chef Chele Gonzalez at Crimson Resort & Spa Mactan, classics with contemporary touches. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Sialo
featured.desc: Sixteen-seat tasting room on President Laurel Street reimagining Filipino flavours; Restaurant of the Year in Best of Cebu 2024. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: DIP
featured.desc: Nikkei restaurant at Sheraton Cebu Mactan Resort — Japanese technique with Peruvian accents. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Island Tea Co. & Ceylon Coffee Club
featured.desc: Island Tea Co. & Ceylon Coffee Club in Moalboal offers a cozy, air-conditioned space with a beautiful interior and fast Wi-Fi, making it a great spot to work or unwind. Visitors consistently praise the outstanding drinks and welcoming atmosphere, though feedback on main food portions can be hit-or-miss. Conveniently located along the Santander-Barili Road, it is best enjoyed for its signature beverages and cafe vibe.

featured.name: Boljoon Parish Museum
featured.desc: Boljoon Parish Museum is a peaceful and solemn heritage site boasting a rich collection, from pre-Spanish archaeological finds to stunning ceiling frescoes and returned historical pulpit panels. Friendly, multilingual guides offer insightful tours that bring the area's deep history to life alongside breathtaking bay views. For the best experience, visit during the daytime, and keep in mind that photography is strictly prohibited inside and entry fees range between ₱30 and ₱75.

featured.name: LTO Extension Licensing Office - North Piazza Elesia
House of Lechon
featured.desc: House of Lechon in Cebu offers a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere paired with exceptionally attentive and warm Filipino hospitality. Diners rave about the legendary lechon with its juicy meat and perfectly crispy skin, as well as standout sides like baked scallops, Langka salad, and buko pandan. Since their famous roast pig can sell out by the evening, it is best to visit earlier in the day to guarantee a taste.

featured.name: SM Cinema - SM Seaside City Cebu
featured.desc: SM Cinema - SM Seaside City Cebu offers a clean and comfortable environment with solid audio quality for a classic movie outing. However, the experience can be marred by notably dim screen projections, lengthy snack counter delays due to understaffing, and serious pest concerns. Visitors are advised to skip the concession stand to avoid long waits and consider opting for brighter films rather than dark horror movies.

featured.name: The Pig and Palm
featured.desc: Featuring a stylish, brutalist-inspired interior and a vibrant atmosphere, The Pig & Palm stands out as a memorable dining destination in Cebu despite occasional noise. Guests consistently rave about the freshly baked brioche with chili jam and outstanding pork specialties like the Kurobuta chop, complemented by attentive service and a solid wine list. To get the best experience, skip the polarizing cauliflower salad, stick to their signature pork dishes, and confirm portion sizes if planning to share.

featured.name: Abaseria Deli & Cafe
featured.desc: Home-style café in Kasambagan built around Cebuano heritage recipes — humba, tablea chocolate cake and a deli counter of local produce. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

featured.name: Pares Batchoy Food House
featured.desc: Earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition, Pares Batchoy Food House is celebrated for its rich Beef Pares with bone marrow alongside flavorful comfort staples like Pork Sisig and Batchoy. The eatery has a simple, busy atmosphere near local hospitals, though service experiences can range from warm and friendly to a bit brusque. Practical tip: stop by early to try their famous bone marrow dish at reasonable prices, but expect a modest, unpretentious setting.

featured.name: Esmen
featured.desc: Small kitchen on F. Rallos Street in Pasil, cooking Cebuano seafood and market produce at neighbourhood prices. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

featured.name: Sun Life - Cebu Business Park CSC
Sugbo Mercado
featured.desc: Sugbo Mercado is a vibrant night market known for its energetic atmosphere, clean setup, and entertaining live music. It offers an incredible variety of food stalls, featuring savory BBQ, street snacks, and standout desserts like Islas's top-rated halo-halo. However, finding a table during peak hours can be challenging, and food preparation may take 20–30 minutes. Practical tip: arrive early and don't wait until you're starving so you can easily secure seating and enjoy the food.

featured.name: PAWS Grooming Pet Supplies and Accessories Shop
Whaleshark Oslob Snorkeling from Moalboal
featured.desc: Embarking on this tour offers a thrilling and unique opportunity to swim alongside majestic whale sharks, sea turtles, and massive sardine shoals. To make the most of your experience and beat the massive crowds, it is essential to start very early in the morning, around 4:00 AM to 7:00 AM. Renting a GoPro can help secure better assistance and photos from the boat crew, while scuba diving offers a quieter alternative to crowded surface waters.

featured.name: Maya
featured.desc: Modern Mexican kitchen and mezcal bar at Crossroads Mall, Banilad. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Pares Pares
featured.desc: Beef pares specialist on N. Escario Street — slow-braised brisket, garlic rice and clear soup. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: Lagunde Sports Complex
featured.desc: Lagunde Sports Complex offers a clean, safe environment featuring a newly painted basketball court, complete equipment, and essential amenities like restrooms and drinking water. Visitors appreciate the accommodating staff and great lighting during official games and leagues. However, keep in mind that evening lighting is restricted on non-game days, so daytime visits are recommended for casual play.

featured.name: Chong Hua Hospital Mandaue
featured.desc: Chong Hua Hospital Mandaue provides a safe, highly professional, and compassionate environment where patients feel comfortably cared for throughout their stay. Key highlights include exceptionally attentive medical staff, modern well-maintained facilities, seamless admission and discharge, and surprisingly high-quality meals. Specialized units like the ER, Radiology, and the Heart Institute are praised for clear communication and top-tier expertise. Practical tip: expect a smooth, stress-free experience from intake to recovery, supported by a prompt and dedicated team.

featured.name: K1 Family KTV
featured.desc: K1 Family KTV offers a clean, comfortable, and exceptionally soundproofed environment that is perfect for both family outings and group gatherings. Highlights include high-quality sound systems with easy-to-use wireless mics, spacious rooms, and fun extra amenities like arcade machines and billiards. The accommodating staff is always quick to assist with equipment, making your karaoke session seamless. Practical tip: Take advantage of their very affordable pricing, such as beer buckets for 500 PHP, for a budget-friendly fun night out.

featured.name: Abli Cebu
featured.desc: Abli Cebu is a cozy, highly popular spot offering creative and elevated Filipino cuisine set in an artistic, comfortable atmosphere with attentive service. Standout highlights include unique, flavorful sauces, dishes like Crispy Cebu Express and Hmmmmba, and delicious "Morta" desserts. Since the venue is small and operates in timed slots, booking a reservation in advance is essential.

featured.name: ATO-AH
featured.desc: Contemporary Filipino dining room in Cebu IT Park, pairing local ingredients with a tasting-menu approach. Michelin Selected 2026.

featured.name: CUR8
featured.desc: Modern bistro at Banilad Town Center serving refined comfort food with bold Filipino and global flavours. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

featured.name: My Greek Taverna
featured.desc: My Greek Taverna in Moalboal offers a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere enhanced by great music, making it an ideal spot for romantic dates or group dinners. Visitors rave about the flavorful, authentic Mediterranean cuisine, highlighting standout dishes like the tender Tria Souvlaki, savory gyros, and delicious chicken parmigiana. Make sure to save room for their spectacular Bougatsa dessert, and enjoy generous portions paired with friendly service at very reasonable prices.

items.name: My Greek Taverna
items.desc: My Greek Taverna in Moalboal offers a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere enhanced by great music, making it an ideal spot for romantic dates or group dinners. Visitors rave about the flavorful, authentic Mediterranean cuisine, highlighting standout dishes like the tender Tria Souvlaki, savory gyros, and delicious chicken parmigiana. Make sure to save room for their spectacular Bougatsa dessert, and enjoy generous portions paired with friendly service at very reasonable prices.

items.name: Fresca Rolled Ice Cream
items.desc: Fresca Rolled Ice Cream is a warm, heart-filled gem in Moalboal, largely celebrated for its vibrant community vibe and the incredibly welcoming service from Iris. Visitors rave about the creative homemade treats, with the local-favorite Mango Float, Ube, and rich Biscoff-Reese's combinations standing out as top picks. Practical tip: portions are generous enough to comfortably share between two to three people.

items.name: De Gustibus
items.desc: De Gustibus offers a beautiful and welcoming atmosphere where incredibly friendly staff—including the sweet owner, Joy—make every guest feel at home. Highlights include fresh, high-quality dishes with excellent vegetarian options, customized breakfasts, and delicious signature drinks at fair prices. Tip: Keep in mind that the menu favors wholesome recipes over fast food like burgers, and restrooms may occasionally lack paper supplies.

items.name: Lokal Kapehan Restobar
items.desc: Lokal Kapehan Restobar offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere, making it an ideal spot for both quiet solo meals and lively group hangouts with board games and karaoke. Guests rave about the generous portion sizes, flavor-packed dishes like sinigang and chicken biryani, oversized cocktails, and thoughtful touches like complimentary infused water. A great practical tip is to share their large dishes and cocktails with friends to make the most of your visit.

items.name: Onward Coffee
items.desc: Onward Coffee in Cebu City offers an unpretentious, cozy atmosphere paired with world-class specialty coffee served by friendly, passionate baristas. Highlights include expertly prepared light-roast pour-overs, excellent flat whites, and their delicious pesto chicken sandwich. Tucked behind Pamahaw Cafe on Wilson Street just a short walk from IT Park, it is an absolute must-visit for serious coffee enthusiasts.

items.name: Alexander Bistro - Cafe
items.desc: Alexander Bistro - Cafe is a highly recommended new spot in Cebu City serving consistently delicious Korean-Mexican fusion dishes like fresh homemade nachos, glazed wings, and bibimbap in a clean, welcoming setting. Guests praise the generous portions, reasonable prices, and warm, attentive staff. Tip: Take advantage of the ample parking during the day, or stay past 9 PM when the space transitions into a fun karaoke restobar.

items.name: Lorenzo's Cafe - Cebu City
items.desc: Lorenzo’s Cafe in Cebu City offers a cozy, welcoming atmosphere with a relaxed vibe, making it an ideal spot for working, studying, or unwinding. Visitors praise the excellent coffee, delicious comfort food, strong Wi-Fi, available power sockets, and friendly service. Practical tip: Since the space is quite compact and seating is limited during peak hours, consider visiting during quieter times to secure a comfortable spot.

items.name: Happy Coffee
items.desc: Tucked just away from the main road in Kasambagan, Happy Coffee offers a cozy, spacious, and family-friendly atmosphere perfect for working, studying, or relaxing with friends. Guests rave about the outstanding 10/10 service, specialty coffee with bright fruity notes, and delicious menu highlights like their breakfasts and Fish Tacos. Practical tip: while the café features wheelchair-accessible pathways and alfresco seating, parking is limited to only about two cars.

items.name: Shangri-La's Mactan Resort and Spa
items.desc: Shangri-La's Mactan Resort and Spa offers a luxurious, family-friendly tropical escape defined by immaculate grounds, an exceptional private beach with clear waters for snorkeling, and legendary hospitality. Guests consistently praise the varied dining options, rejuvenating spa services, engaging kids' activities, and the outstanding Ocean Wing Lounge. For families, upgrading to a Main Wing Family Room provides convenient access to amenities and child-friendly features, though keep in mind that room service can experience delays during peak occupancy times.

items.name: Crimson Resort and Spa Mactan
items.desc: Crimson Resort and Spa Mactan offers a warm, relaxing, and highly accessible atmosphere suitable for multi-generational families, couples, and solo travelers alike. Highlights include exceptionally attentive staff, excellent pool and beach facilities, scenic buggy rides, and quality dining at Azure Beach Club and Saffron. Practical tips: light sleepers may want to request a quieter room due to thin walls, and you may need to remind housekeeping to replenish daily toiletries and bottled water.

items.name: Jpark Island Resort and Waterpark, Cebu
items.desc: Jpark Island Resort and Waterpark is an expansive, kid-friendly destination packed with fun features like the Amazon River pool, themed Pororo suites, and diverse dining at The Abalone Buffet. Guests love the spacious rooms, friendly staff, and convenient resort buggies, though some mention that older pool facilities need maintenance and restaurant orders can take time. Practical tips include ordering room service in advance, enjoying peaceful early morning beach walks, and opting for the newer Jpark Tower for modern amenities.

items.name: Movenpick Hotels & Resorts
items.desc: Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts in Cebu delivers a warm, relaxing, and homey atmosphere defined by world-class staff hospitality and delightful perks like the daily Chocolate Hour. Guests consistently praise the attentive service, excellent dining, and strong property security. While the overall experience is stellar, some rooms and the pool show signs of age and could use updating. Practical tip: bring water shoes for the rocky beach section and pack extra treats if you want to make friends with the cute resident guard dogs.
